create_GFPOTrainer: create a GFPOTrainer instance with model, reward functions, and a group filter function for grouped filtered preference optimization
run_GFPO_training: run grouped filtered preference optimization training with custom reward functions and per-group completion filtering
generate_and_score_completions: generate and score model completions with multimodal image inputs and compute grouped advantages for training
filter_group_completions: filter group completions using a custom group filter function to retain only top-scoring completions per group
compute_importance_sampling_ratio: compute importance sampling ratio to correct distribution mismatch when using vLLM for generation
